cover_headline: AbbVie Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenue Rises 10% to $17.4 Billion and 2026 EPS Guidance Is Raised
facts: Adjusted earnings of $3.82 per share beat the $3.74 Zacks consensus, on revenue of $17.404 billion, up 10.3%
Skyrizi revenue rose 22.9% to $5.776 billion and Rinvoq rose 24.3% to $2.706 billion, while Humira fell 30.6% to $683 million
AbbVie raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $13.95-$13.99, lifted its revenue outlook to about $67.8 billion and raised the dividend 5.2% to $1.82 per share

quote.text: AbbVie continues to deliver outstanding results, reflecting solid execution across our diverse portfolio.
quote.speaker: Robert A. Michael

end.headline: AbbVie Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenue Rises 10% to $17.4 Billion and 2026 EPS Guidance Is Raised
end.line: Adjusted EPS of $3.82 topped estimates as Skyrizi and Rinvoq grew more than 22% each, prompting a guidance raise, a higher Skyrizi target and a 5.2% dividend increase.
